name: insta-followers-track
description: Follower Tracker - see who unfollowed you on Instagram. Free, local, no telemetry. Chrome, Firefox and Safari.

scripts.safari: npm run build && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari --project-location dist/safari-xcode --app-name "Follower Tracker" --bundle-identifier digital.arrows.followertracker --macos-only --no-open --no-prompt
scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.dev: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
